Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ১) A shopkeeper fixes the marked price of an item 35% above its cost price. The percentage of discount allowed to gain 8% is = ?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Let C.P.=Tk. 100 
Then, 
 M.P. = Tk. 135,
S.P. =Tk.108
∴Discount %  =(27/135 ×100)% =20%

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ২) If a man estimates his loss as 20% of the selling price, then his loss percent is = ?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
According to the question,
Loss = 20% Selling price
i.e.
Loss/ Selling price = 1/5
∴ Cost price = Selling price + Loss
= 5 + 1
= 6
∴Loss%=1/6 ×100=50/3%

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ৩) To gain 10% on selling the mixture of milk and water at the cost price of pure milk, the quantity of water to be mixed with 50 kg of pure milk is = ?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Let cost price of 1 kg = Tk. 1
Cost price of 50 kg = Tk. 50
⇒Profit= (10/ 100)×50
=Tk. 5        
∴Quantity to added= 5/1=5 kg

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ৪) A man bought oranges at the rate of 8 for Tk. 34 and sold them at the rate of 12 for Tk. 57. How many oranges should be sold to earn a net profit of Tk. 45?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
CP of 1 orange
= Tk.34/8
= Tk.4.25
SP of 1 orange
=Tk. 57/12
=Tk.4.75
Profit on each apple = (4.75 - 4.25) = Tk. 0.50
∴ Number of apples required
= 45/ 0.50
=90

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ৫) A house worth Tk. 150000 is sold by X at a 5% profit to Y, Y sells the house back to X at a 2% loss. Then find profit and loss in the entire transaction = ?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Money spent by X = Tk. 150000
Money received by X = 105% of Tk. 150000 = Tk. 157500
C.P. to X = 98% of Tk. 157500 = Tk. 154350
∴ X gains Tk. (157500 - 154350) = Tk. 3150

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ৬) List price of a book is Tk. 100. A dealer sells three such books for Tk. 274.50 after allowing discount at a certain rate, find the rate of discount = ?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Given,
= MRP of book = Tk. 100
= Selling price of 3 books = Tk. 274.50
= Selling price of 1 book = Tk. 91.50
Discount on each book
= 100 - 91.50 = Tk. 8.50
Therefore discount %
=8.50/100×100%
=8.50%

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ৭) Prateek sold a music system to Karthik at 20% gain and karthik sold it to Swastik at 40% gain. If Swastik paid Tk. 10500 for the music system, What amount did Prateek pay for the same?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Let the price paid by Prateek be Tk. x
Then,
140% of 120% of x=10500
⇒(140/100)×(120/100)×x=10500
⇒ x=(10500×25/42)=6250

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ৮) A shopkeeper earns a profit of 12% on selling a book at 10% discount on the printed price. The ratio of the cost price and the printed price of the book is = ?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
According to the question,
Cost Price : Marked Price
(100 - Discount) : (100 + Profit)
100 - 10 : 100 + 12
90 : 112
45 : 56

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ৯) Rokeya bought 30 kg of wheat at the rate of Tk. 9.50 per kg and 40 kg of wheat at the rate of Tk. 8.50 per kg and mixed them. She sold the mixture at the rate of Tk. 8.90 per kg. Her total profit or loss in the transaction was -
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
C.P. of 70 kg wheat
= Tk. (30 × 9.50 + 40 × 8.50)
= Tk. (285 + 340)
= Tk. 625
S.P. of 70 kg wheat
= Tk. (70 × 8.90)
= Tk. 623
∴ Loss = Tk. (625 - 623) = Tk. 2

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ১০) A book vendor sold a book at loss of 10%. Had he sold it for Tk. 108 more, he would have earned a profit of 10%. Find the cost of the book = ?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Given loss = 10% profit = 10%
Difference of overall profit and loss = 10 - (-10) = 20%
20% of cp = sp
20/ 100×cp = 108
20 × cp = 108 × 100
cp = 10800/20
∴ cp = 540

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ১১) A fruit seller sells mangoes at the rate of Tk. 9 per kg and thereby loses 20%. At what price per kg, he should have sold, them to make a profit of 5%?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Let the new S.P. be Tk. x
Then,80:9=105:x
⇒x=(9×105/ 80)=11.81

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ১২) A man wanted to sell an article with 20% profit: but he actually sold at 20% loss for Tk. 480, at what price he wanted to sell it to earn the profit = ?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
According to the question,
Loss 20%
Selling price
=100%−20=80%    
80%=480
1=480/80
∴(Profit 20%) = 480/ 80 ×120    
=Tk. 720

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ১৩) A trader buys some goods for Tk. 150. If the overhead expenses be 12% of cost price, then at what price should it be sold to earn 10%?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Total C.P. = Cost + Overhead Expenses
= Tk. (150 + 12% of 150)
= Tk. (150 + 18)
= Tk. 168
∴S.P.=Tk.(110/100×168)=Tk. 184.80

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ১৪) A total profit of Tk. 3,600 is to be distributed amongst A, B and C such that A : B = 5 : 4 and B : C = 8 : 9. The share of C in the profit is:
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
A Total Profit = Tk 3600
Profit ratio,
A : B = 5 : 4
B : C = 8 : 9
As B is common in both ratio, we make B equal in both ratio by multiplying One B in another.
A : B = 5 : 4 × 8
B : C = 8 × 4 : 9
So, ratio of
A : B : C = 40 : 32 : 36 = 10 : 8 : 9
Now,
C shares in profit = (3600×9)/27
= Tk 1200

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ১৫) A person having bought goods for Tk 400 sells half of it at a gain of 5%, at what gain % must he sell the remainder so as to gain 20% on the whole?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
To gain 20% on whole he must sell all good for,
400 + 20% of 400 = 480
As he get 5% gain on half of the goods i.e.
200 + 5% of 200 = 210
So required balance = 480 - 210 = 270
He must gain Tk. 70 on rest Tk. 200
% gain on remainder goods =(70×100)/200 = 35%

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ১৬) A dishonest dealer marks up the price of his goods by 20% and gives a discount of 10% to the customer. He also uses a 900 gram weight instead of a 1 kilogram weight. Find his percentage profit due to these maneuvers?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Let CP = Tk 1 per gram
Then SP of 1000gram is 1000 + 20% of 1000 = Tk 1200
Now Dealer gives 10% discount = 1200 - 10% of 1200 = Tk. 1080
Then, Dealer is dishonest and sells 900 g is 1080
And, CP of 900 grams is 900
Profit = 1080 - 900 = 180
∴ % profit = (180×100)/900= 20%

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ১৭) A bicycle marked at Tk. 2,000, is sold with two successive discount of 20% and 10%.An additional discount of 5% is offered for cash payment. The selling price of the bicycle at cash payment is:
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Marked Price = 2000
SP after first Discount of 20% = 2000 - 20% of 2000 = 1600
SP after second Discount of 10% = 1600 - 10% of 1600 = 1440
Now, the final selling price at cash = 1440 - 5% of 1440 = Tk. 1368

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ১৮) A trader mixes 26 kg of rice at Tk. 20 per kg with 30 kg of rice of other variety at Tk. 36 per kg and sells the mixture at Tk. 30 per kg. His profit percent is:
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
C.P. of 56 kg rice = (26 x 20 + 30 x 36)
=(520 + 1080)
=1600.
S.P. of 56 kg rice = (56 x 30)
= 1680.
Gain = 80x100% = 5%.

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ১৯) When a plot is sold for 18,700, the owner loses 15%. At what price must that plot be sold in order to gain 15%?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
85 : 18700 = 115 : x
x = 18700 x 115

Hence, S.P. = 25,300.

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ২০) A shopkeeper expects a gain of 22.5% on his cost price. If in a week, his sale was of Tk 392, what was his profit?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
C.P. = (100/122.5)x 392
=  (1000/1225)x 392
= 320
Profit = (392 - 320) = 72.

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ২১) In a barrack of soldiers there was stock of food for 190 days for 4000 soldiers. After 30 days 800 soldiers left the barrack. For how many days shall the left over food last for the remaining soldiers?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Let the remaining food last for x days
4000 soldiers had provision for 160 days
3200 soldiers had provision for x days
Less men, More days (Indirect proportion)
∴3200:4000::160:x
⇔ 3200x=4000×160
⇔ x= (4000×160)/ 3200
⇔ x = 200

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ২২) A rope makes 70 rounds of the circumference of a cylinder whose radius of the base is 14 cm. How many times can it go round a cylinder with radius 20 cm?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Let the required number of rounds be x
More radius, Less rounds (Indirect proportion)
∴ 20:14::70:x
⇔(20×x)=(14×70)
⇔ x= (14×70)/ 20
⇔ x=49

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ২৩) A wall of 100 meters can be built by 7 men or 10 women in 10 days. How many days will 14 men and 20 women take to build a wall of 600 metres?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Let the required number of days be x
7 men = 10 women
(14 men and 20 women) = (20 + 20) women = 40 women
More length, More days (Direct proportion)
More women, Less days (Indirect proportion)
Length 100:600 & Women 40:10} :: 10:x
∴ 100×40×x = 600×10×10
⇔ x = (600×10×10)(100×40)
⇔ x = 15

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ২৪) 3 pumps, working 8 hours a day, can empty a tank in 2 days. How many hours a day must 4 pumps work to empty the tank in 1 day?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Let the required number of working hours per day be x
More pumps, Less working hours per day (Indirect proportion)
Less days, More working hours per day (Indirect proportion)
Pumps 4:3 & Days 1:2 } :: 8:x
∴ 4×1×x = 3×2×8
⇔ x = (3×2×8)/(4)
⇔ x = 12

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ২৫) A man completes 5/8 of a job in 10 days. At this rate, how many more days will it takes him to finish the job?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Work done = 5/8
Balance work =(1 - 5/8) = 3/8
Let the required number of days be x.
Then,(5/8 : 3/8)= :: 10 : x ⇔ 5/8 × x = 3/8 × 10
x = 3/8 × 10 × 8/5
⇒ x = 6.

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ২৬) In a hostel, Food was available for 2000 students for 54 days, but after 15 days more students joined hostel and food lasts only for 20 more days. Determine how many students came in hostel?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
As it is given that food is there for 54 days for 2000 students,
But after 15 days, remaining food was sufficient for 2000 students for 39 days only ( as 54-15 = 39 )
Let x number of students came in hostel after 15 days,
=> Total number of students after 15 days = 2000 + x
=> Remaining food was enough for (2000 + x) students for 20 days
So here is indirect proportion, as more people and less food
=> 2000 : ( 2000 + x ) :: 20 : 39
=> 2000× 39 = (2000 + x )× 20
=> 3900 = 2000 + x
=> x = 3900 - 2000
=> x = 1900

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ২৭) If a quarter kg of potato costs 60 paise, how many paise will 200gm cost?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Quarter of Kg means 250 gm×
Less weight, less price (Direct Proportion)
So,
250:200::60:x
=> x=(200×60)/250
=>x=48
So 200 gm will cost 48 paise.

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ২৮) 36 men can complete a piece of work in 18 days. In how many days will 27 men complete the same work?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Let the required number of days be x.
Less men, More days (Indirect Proportion)
∴27:36::18:x
⇒27×x=36×18
⇒x =(36×18)/27
⇒x=24

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ২৯) In a camp, there is a meal for 120 men or 200 children. If 150 children have taken the meal, how many men will be catered to with remaining meal?
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
There is a meal for 200 children. 150 children have taken the meal.
Remaining meal is to be catered to 50 children.
Now, 200 children 120 men.
50 children (120/200)x 50 = 30 men.

Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.question: ৩০) A wheel that has 6 cogs is meshed with a larger wheel of 14 cogs. When the smaller wheel has made 21 revolutions, then the number of revolutions made by the larger wheel is:
Profit & Loss, Chain Rule.exp:
Let the required number of revolutions made by larger wheel be x.
Then, More cogs, Less revolutions (Indirect Proportion)
14 : 6 :: 21 : x
or, 14 x x = 6 x 21
or, x = (6 x 21)/14
so, x = 9.
